versions.changelog: The API key is now optional to load this skill; with no key, a pointer leads to a temporary free key with no signup and a link the user opens to keep it.
Entity lists no longer point at the internal id; urlSlug is the stable handle for metric calls.

One definition of the current Score, same-date Score gaps, unresolved product parents, a call budget before a watchlist fan-out, node counts that include the root, and ids treated as labels rather than addresses.
Fix: at depth 2 every graph group spans both hops, so peers are taken from depth 1 or filtered to slugs with an edge to the root.

Adds the relationship layer: one GET /api/v1/stocks/{ticker}/graph call returns a company's people, products, product families, peers and organizations with the typed edge between each pair, keyed by the same urlSlug handles the metrics endpoint takes. Three new workflows (who an entity is to the company, product families, peers and connected organizations), the edge vocabulary and direction convention, the truncated cap rule, and the three error shapes. Existing workflows unchanged; search example updated to the issuer-first ranking.

First publish. Company knowledge graph for AI agents: resolve the people and products behind a ticker, find any tracked entity by name, and compare each one's SentiSense Score over the same window. Resolution and single-ticker traversal only.
